en: Vintage monochrome image of a lake or pond with small rowboats, tree‑lined banks, and a promenade. On the right side stands an octagonal pavilion with many windows; in the background are more buildings, including one with a pointed tower. People stroll and sit along the waterfront. The caption at the bottom left reads "Graz, Hilmteich." The image has a yellowish border and aging typical of early 20th‑century postcards.
